publication_blockers: clinician-family conflict rendered from one side only
mockery of hope, faith, anger, denial, relief, or absence guilt
rendering_rules: Use role language rather than character judgments.
Keep patient preference separate from family preference.
Do not frame hospice/palliative care teams as family judges.
Avoid “toxic family” shorthand in public copy.
When safety is involved, route to local professional/emergency resources rather than publishing instructions.
